title: RFC 4180 single-line CSV parser
contract: Comma-separated fields; a field starting with a quote is quoted, where commas are literal and "" is one quote. Quotes are only special at field start. Whitespace is never trimmed. Empty input is one empty field; a trailing comma adds a trailing empty field. Null input, an unterminated quoted field, and text after a closing quote all throw IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: a field that is only an escaped quote
